Nutrition Therapy
Nutrition Diagnosis
Common nutrition diagnoses for individuals with hypertension 
include excessive energy intake; excessive or inappropriate in-
take of fats; excessive sodium intake; inadequate calcium, ﬁ ber, 
potassium, or magnesium intake; overweight/obesity; food and 
nutrition-related knowledge deﬁ cit; and physical inactivity.
